title: Simple Pendulum Period in Small-Angle Limit
question: Derive the period of a simple pendulum in the small-angle limit from Newton's second law, and verify its dimensions are those of time.

title: Feigenbaum Constant Convergence
question: Measure Feigenbaum's constant delta from the period-doubling cascade of the logistic map x -> r*x*(1-x). Does it converge to ~4.6692?

title: Lyapunov Exponent of Logistic Map at r=4
question: Numerically estimate the Lyapunov exponent of the logistic map at r=4 and show it is positive (deterministic chaos).

title: Kepler's Third Law from Inverse-Square Force
question: Derive Kepler's third law (T^2 proportional to a^3) from an inverse-square central force for a circular orbit.

title: Energy Conservation in Time-Independent Lagrangians
question: Show that for a Lagrangian with no explicit time dependence, the energy (Hamiltonian) is conserved — a concrete case of Noether's theorem.
